Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, random
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
name=z.namelist()[1]
d=bytearray(z.read(name))
for i in range(256):
    x=bytearray(d)
    x[-1]^=i
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(x)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('hit',i,r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
        break
else:
    print('none')
PY

message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, itertools
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
base=bytearray(z.read(z.namelist()[1]))
for pos in range(len(base)):
  for val in range(256):
    x=bytearray(base); x[pos]=val
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(x)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1)
    if r.returncode!=0:
      print('hit pos',pos,'val',val,'rc',r.returncode)
      print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
      raise SystemExit
print('none')
PY
